## Summary
Ascenta is a modern web development and AI automation agency specializing in high-performance web applications, intelligent autonomous AI agents, sub-second conversational voice bots, and enterprise workflow automations. Founded by Muhammad Rayyan, the agency focuses on turning ambiguous client operations into resilient, automated digital systems.

## Core Services & Architectural Specifications

### 1. Web Development & Engineering
- Frameworks: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion
- Architectural Pillars:
  - Sub-second First Contentful Paint (FCP) and Largest Contentful Paint (LCP)
  - Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
  - Semantic HTML5 with complete ARIA compliance and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility
  - Server-Side Rendering (SSR) & Static Site Generation (SSG) for complete search indexability
  - Native conversion paths and lead-capture pipelines

### 2. Autonomous AI Agents
- Core Capabilities:
  - WhatsApp Business Cloud API & Webhooks
  - Instagram Messaging API (DMs, comments, mentions)
  - Schema-enforced tool execution using Zod and OpenAI / Anthropic function calling
  - Long-term memory persistence with PostgreSQL / Supabase vector stores
  - Multi-language and code-switched NLP support (English, Urdu, Hinglish, Arabic)
  - Autonomous lead qualification, scheduling, order lookups, and human agent handoff

### 3. Voice AI & Conversational Phone Engines
- Architectural Specifications:
  - Low-latency bidirectional WebSocket audio streaming (Twilio Media Streams)
  - Real-time speech-to-text (STT) via Deepgram Nova-2 (<180ms)
  - Ultra-fast token streaming through Claude / GPT models
  - Neural text-to-speech (TTS) via Cartesia Sonic and ElevenLabs Turbo v2 (<250ms)
  - Total end-to-end conversational turnaround under 800ms
  - Native speech interruption (barge-in) and background acoustic filtering

### 4. Enterprise Workflow Automation & n8n Clusters
- Connectors: Webhooks, REST APIs, Gmail, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, Slack, Stripe, HubSpot, Airtable
- Fault Tolerance: Automatic exponential backoff retries, error alerting, dead-letter queues, and immutable execution logs

### 5. Custom CRM & Internal Operational Hubs
- Purpose: Eliminate exorbitant per-seat SaaS licensing costs for growing businesses
- Features: Real-time customer pipelines, automated lead scoring (0-100), activity timelines, permission-based role access, and interactive data visualization dashboards

## Client Case Studies & Production Proof

### CleanData AI, Autonomous Data Specialist SaaS
- Problem: Data teams waste 20+ hours weekly cleaning spreadsheets, normalizing dates and phone numbers, and redacting sensitive PII before LLMs can consume the data.
- Solution: Built a multi-mode AI SaaS platform that ingests raw CSVs or unstructured narrative prose, strips PII, stores data in an embedded SQLite engine with a browser SQL query console, and syncs vector embeddings across Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB, and Supabase.
- Live URL: https://cleandata-ruddy.vercel.app

### Instagram Multimodal AI Agent & CRM System
- Problem: E-commerce and agency brands lose over 60% of social media leads due to delayed DM replies and failure to parse customer voice notes or sent screenshots.
- Solution: Architected an end-to-end Next.js 15 CRM with Meta Graph API webhooks, Groq Whisper voice note transcription, Vision LLM image interpretation, live typing indicators, and instant human agent takeover.

### Sub-800ms Conversational Voice Calling Assistant
- Problem: Traditional AI phone systems suffer from 2.5-second pauses, creating an awkward, robotic experience that results in customer hang-ups.
- Solution: Engineered a bidirectional WebSocket streaming engine with parallelized STT, LLM inference, and TTS generation, cutting latency under 800ms with natural human cadence.
